## Execution tips

- Grasp the straight middle section of the vertical handle on the oven door's front right, avoiding upper and lower attachments. Surround it from left and right, matching the opening to handle width and surrounding clearance.
- Before closing, confirm the pads are in effective grasp positions on both sides of the handle, rather than merely overlapping it in the image and actually grasping the door or right-side panel.
- The oven door rotates around the hinge on the front left. Adjust gripper orientation and pulling direction with the door’s rotation to avoid slipping or jamming from pulling hard along a fixed straight line.
- When the left arm approaches the right handle, orient in the open space in front of the oven door. Leave clearance from the large yellow-green bottle on the right and the door's forward-left swing to reduce wrist or forearm collisions.
